'''Huan''' was a [[Tairen]] and uncle to [[Siuan Sanche]].

==History==
Huan was a gambler and a ne'er-do-well person. He was also a hero who died pulling children out of a burning building.{{ref/book|3|20}} Siuan once told [[Moiraine Damodred]] about Huan and that he died proving what a good man he was.{{ref/book|0|6}} Siuan also told [[Matrim Cauthon]] that he reminds her of her uncle.{{ref/book|3|20}}
